def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    
    orig = bins[valid] - rem[valid] + item
    frac = rem[valid] / (orig + 1e-7)
    
    scores[valid] = -np.abs(frac - 0.5) + (1.5 / (rem[valid] + 1e-5))
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    
    orig = bins[valid] - rem[valid] + item
    ratio = rem[valid] / (orig + 1e-7)
    scores[valid] = np.cos(np.pi * ratio) - 2.0 * ratio
    return scores
